local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local t=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 t=t+dt;if t<.2 then return end;t=0
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during original Kvatch NPC defense')
 if core.isWorldPaused() then return end
 local scamps=0
 for _,actor in ipairs(nearby.actors) do
  if actor.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x03e9cb) then
   scamps=scamps+1
   print('KvatchDefense original Scamp id='..tostring(actor.id)..' dead='..tostring(types.Actor.isDead(actor))..' position='..tostring(actor.position))
  end
 end
 print('KvatchDefense control ready scamps='..scamps..' position='..tostring(self.position)..' cell='..tostring(self.cell.name))
end}}}}
